focus: Patch_AbilityStartedCasting: wrapping Ability.preCastActions to reveal traits when the lead-in effect starts; check call order of Notify_StartedCasting vs AddRange, re-wrapping, save/load of preCastActions
diffSource: since build 35 (2026-10-06T05:38:23Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Postfix re-wraps leftover preCastActions from an interrupted cast
findings.detail: Notify_StartedCasting appends with AddRange (Ability.cs:1016), and vanilla clears the list only at the end of Activate (556, 571) and on the invalid-target cancel in WarmupTick (938). If the cast job ends another way (target despawned, stun, draft, job replaced), the old entries stay. The next cast's postfix then wraps them again, adding layers and repeat reveal calls. Reveals do nothing once the trait is discovered, so nothing breaks, but the fix is small: add a Prefix(Ability __instance, out int __state) that saves PreCastActions(__instance)?.Count ?? 0, and start the Postfix loop at __state so only this call's new entries get wrapped.

findings.title: No early reveal when a game is loaded mid-warmup; existing Notify_PawnUsedVerb fallback applies
findings.detail: Ability never saves preCastActions, and Notify_StartedCasting is called only from JobDriver Notify_Starting (JobDriver_CastAbility.cs:36 and its Melee/World variants), so after a mid-cast load the list is empty. Vanilla also skips the fire-spew flames in that case. The reveal falls back to Notify_PawnUsedVerb (Hediff_Titan.cs:678). Nothing needs saving or rebuilding.

findings.title: New patch target not recorded in the Schematic
findings.detail: verify_patches says Ability.Notify_StartedCasting is not in the Schematic; update it if this patch is meant to stay.

checked: precedents: no corpus mod patches Ability.Notify_StartedCasting, so no shared approach and nothing that could clash
call order: the postfix runs after vanilla's AddRange loop (Ability.cs:1012-1018), so the new entries are present
PreCastAction is a struct; reading list[i].ticksAwayFromCast before writing list[i] is safe; each wrapper keeps its own copy of 'original'
pre-cast actions run from WarmupTick inside AbilitiesTick, which loops by index; TryDiscoverBy/Discover don't add or remove abilities, so no collection-modified exception
save/load: preCastActions is never saved by Ability, so nothing to persist or rebuild
Notify_AbilityEffectStarted uses the same UsesGrantedAbility trigger and PlayerCanObserve gate as the existing Notify_PawnUsedVerb path
HasHiddenTraitGranting / GetTitan null-guard ordinary pawns before the reflection access
